page.title: The Forge Roblox Codes, Controls & Beginner Guide
page.meta_description: The Forge is a Roblox RPG about mining, forging and fighting. Learn the controls, how to play, beginner tips, and what we know about codes.
page.tagline: Mine rare ores, forge over 1,000 item variations and fight your way across new islands in The Forge.
overview: The Forge is a Roblox RPG and simulation game built around three loops: mining, forging and fighting. Every ore combination you forge produces a unique design with its own traits, so the gear you end up with is shaped by the materials you choose. There are more than 1,000 forging variations to chase, and you can build your character to suit your own style rather than following a single meta path.

Progression comes from mining rare ores, defeating enemies, and collecting runes that enhance your items. New islands and content are added with each update, so the map and the ore pool keep expanding. The game is openly labelled a beta release — the developers ask players to report bugs and suggestions in their community server.

A server holds up to 12 players, so runs stay small enough that you can actually see what other people are forging. If you searched for The Forge Roblox codes, be aware that neither the Roblox page nor the sources we checked list any codes or a redemption system — everything below is what the game itself documents.

how_to_play: Join a server through the Roblox game page — the experience runs on PC, Mac, mobile, tablet, Xbox, PlayStation and VR.
Head out and mine rare ores. Rarer materials feed into better forging combinations later.
Take your ores to the forge and combine them. Each ore combination gives a unique design and distinct traits, and there are over 1,000 variations to discover.
Fight enemies with your forged gear to earn progression and unlock more of the game.
Collect runes and use them to enhance your items, pushing your build further.
Explore new islands and take on the content added in each update.
Tune your build to your own style — the game is designed so you can play the way you want rather than following one fixed loadout.
tips: Read the trait on every forge before you commit — the same ore combination gives a distinct design and traits, so experimenting is the point, not a waste.
Mine rarer ores early. Your forging options are only as good as the materials sitting in your inventory.
Bind F (block) into your muscle memory before you go looking for tougher enemies — blocking is a listed control, so use it.
Dash (Q) and sprint (Shift) are your travel tools between mining spots and fights; use them to cut down on downtime.
Save runes for gear you actually intend to keep, since runes enhance items rather than unlocking new ones.
The game is in beta — if something breaks, report it in the community server the developers mention on the Roblox page instead of assuming it's intended.

faq.q: Are there any The Forge Roblox codes?
faq.a: The Roblox page we checked doesn't list any codes, and neither do the other sources for this page. There is no confirmed code redemption system or active code list we can point you to, so treat any code list you see elsewhere with suspicion until the developers post one officially.
